needs.what: Station symbols (721) on keyword and triggered abilities: a `threshold: {counter: charge, at_least: N}` that makes the permanent HAVE a keyword (4+ | Flying) or a triggered ability (8+ | Multivector Assault Mode -- the combat-damage-to-an-opponent trigger that deals that much damage to each other opponent) only at N+ charge counters, plus the Spacecraft rule that the permanent is an artifact creature with its printed 6/6 only at 4+ charge counters (its 'It's an artifact creature at 4+' reminder) and a noncreature artifact below it. The Station activation itself (tap_permanents with `as` + add_counters by power_of) is expressible today
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Ability.threshold is accepted only on activated abilities (packet notes: 'Activated abilities only'); a static grant_keyword or trigger `condition` on counters_on would leave the ability on the permanent, which the notes forbid for striations; and nothing gates the Spacecraft becoming a 6/6 artifact creature at 4+ -- a counters-conditioned set_types/set_pt static would be an invented approximation of rule 721 rather than the station mechanic
